experiments.intended_outcome: Select a premise with clearer suspense or comedy than the rejected story
experiments.evidence_needed: Two or three genuinely different boards; explicit owner feedback or a clearly labeled review
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: No full render before stronger story evaluation; reject repetitive or unearned arcs

experiments.intended_outcome: Better visible acting and prop continuity
experiments.evidence_needed: Hardest-contact interval, three distinct poses, encoded motion review
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: Hold if the limb must stretch or a key action is unreadable

experiments.intended_outcome: One causal collision that improves the chosen story
experiments.evidence_needed: Scene-specific geometry, stable bake, no-force control, negative tests and rendered-state match
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: Do not expand into body physics or scientific claims without separate work

experiments.intended_outcome: Choose the cheapest representation that preserves a needed reveal
experiments.evidence_needed: Matched short shot, alternate-view or mask proof, review of exposed surfaces
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: Stop if 2.5D cannot show the required unseen surface honestly

experiments.intended_outcome: Choose clearer, more natural speech for the actual tone
experiments.evidence_needed: Representative clips, pronunciation check and real listening feedback
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: Technical synthesis success alone does not settle voice choice

experiments.intended_outcome: See whether drawn reasoning improves a mechanism explanation
experiments.evidence_needed: One short progressively drawn relationship with accurate underlying geometry
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: Reject jitter that changes factual dimensions or distracts from the action

experiments.intended_outcome: Demonstrate a materially different visual construction
experiments.evidence_needed: Original sprite/grid or true block scene, readable action, correct scale and export
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: A palette filter or title change is only a variant

experiments.intended_outcome: Test a bounded atmospheric or transition use where exact identity is not essential
experiments.evidence_needed: Exact model/version/rights, input/output, defect review and local resource evidence
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: Hold for access/license/hardware problems; do not use unvalidated generation for exact-count logic

experiments.intended_outcome: Establish speech intelligibility and score suitability
experiments.evidence_needed: Listening of actual final audio, including names, transitions and payoff
experiments.stop_or_hold_condition: Keep blocked if no listener or audio access is available

closing: These are proposed adoption experiments, not authorizations for new installations, paid compute, accounts, uploads, outreach or publication. Prefer already available tools. A new dependency should win a real comparison on quality, controllability, maintainability or accepted-output effort.
